Decode payload first. JSON [rows,body]. Each row [field,successors] lists allowed next fields; split successors and body on ASCII spaces retaining empty fields. In body, ~N; replaces N fields: fill them with the UNIQUE directed walk of N+1 edges from the preceding literal field to the following literal field in rows. Endpoints stay once; reject absent or ambiguous walks. Join fields with ASCII spaces, preserve every other character; print only.
